sentences.text: Advocate for the Petitioner : MR H R A CHOUDHURY Advocate for the Respondent : GA, ASSAM

BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUMAN SHYAM  ORDER Date : 15-09-2023 Heard Mr. H.R.A. Choudhury, learned Sr. counsel assisted by Mr. M.U. Mondal,
learned counsel for the writ petitioner.

Land measuring 03 Bigha along with RCC (G+2) commercial building belonging to the petitioner had been acquired by the District Administration of Goalpara vide notification dated 18-12-2021 for construction of four lane highway.
According to the petitioner the total value of the land and building, for the purpose of payment of compensation, is to the tune of Rs. 5,39,48,937/-.
However,

by ignoring the correct value of the land and building, the authorities are proposing to pay only Rs.
3,00,000/- as compensation to the petitioner.
It has further been alleged that the authorities are in the process of demolishing the building.

Page No.# 3/4 Mr. H.R.A. Choudhury submits that if the building is demolished prior to determination and/ or deposit of compensation, the same would result into irreparable loss and injury to the petitioner.
Hence, this writ petition.

Ms. R. Bora, learned standing counsel, NHIDCL appearing for the respondent No. 2 and 3 seeks 10 days time to obtain instruction and apprise this Court as to whether, any notice under Section 3(G)
of the National Highway Act, 1956 has been issued in this case for acquisition of the land and if so,
produce the notice.

sentences.text: In view of the prayer made by Ms. Bora, this writ petition is directed to be posted again on 27-09-2023 for motion, as a fixed item.

Ms. R. Devi, learned CGC appearing for the respondent No. 1 and Ms. S. Baruah, learned Govt.
Advocate, Assam appearing for the official respondents to also obtain instruction, responding to the above noted allegation made in the writ petition on or before the next date fixed.
One extra copy each of the writ petition be furnished to the respective departmental counsel.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and for ends of justice, it is hereby provided that status quo as regards the RCC building and the land of the petitioner shall be maintained till the next date.
